notes.title: Passion Rift Release! PLAY NOW!
notes.notes:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44758768/60e8369c12ba8f22a3ed8a211a560f47f94a137b.jpg

Welcome to the show across worlds!

We’re live. Passion Rift is a surreal multi-realm reality show where you build a squad, shape evolving relationships, and compete in automated battles while making quick decisions under pressure. Expect striking visuals, juicy storylines, and progression you can feel every session.

What’s inside:
 Idle combat: assemble your squad and let them battle through waves of enemies using unique skills and synergies.
 Character progression: unlock skills, gear, perks, and rise to global fame.
 Flirt system: build bonds, unlock dialogues, and collect cute outfits for each girl.
 Corporate intrigue: uncover the dark truth behind the portal and the show's creators.
 Reality show survival: compete, progress, and become a global star… or die trying.
 Explore alien worlds: dangerous dimensions filled with monsters, tech, and secrets.


🎁 Launch Promo Code
Code: RAREBOOST
Rewards:
 Rare Character: Seven
 Epic Gear Set for Seven: Obedience Ritual
 15x Seven’s Fame (used to evolve this character)
 750x Awards (universal resource for upgrading all characters)
 500x Aurix (premium currency)


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3578240/Passion_Rift

Play on Steam, share your thoughts in Discussions, and leave a review. Your feedback will help set the pace for upcoming updates!

See you on air. 🎬

🔗 What's New?

[olist]
 Interactive Toy Integration: Lovense toys now sync seamlessly with game scenes, responding to the narrative and actions you take.

Join us in this exciting update and experience Pocket Waifu Rekindled on a deeper, more intimate level. Dive into the demo today and explore the endless possibilities that await! 🚀💖

notes.title: Demo Summary and first changes!
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing the PWR demo and giving us feedback via surveys! We have already started to implement the first improvements based on your comments. Among them, we have improved the quality of backgrounds in the game.

We will release the second edition of the demo in June, which will be the last step before the release.

Thank you for your support!
